title: The agentic enterprise needs more than intelligent AI: It needs trusted AI
summary: AI agents are increasingly capable of independently executing various business tasks, thus transforming enterprise operations. As organisations adopt these technologies, trust and accountability are becoming crucial elements for successful integration. Research indicates that many enterprises already use AI agents and plan to expand their usage in the near future. Proper governance and transparency are needed to ensure safe operation of these agents.
